name: @santi020k/website-motion
description: Local films of the design history of santi020k.com.

scripts.build: pnpm run prepare:assets && astro build && node scripts/prepare-compositions.mjs
scripts.check:composition: HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 hyperframes check dist/portrait --strict && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 hyperframes check dist/square --strict && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 hyperframes check dist/landscape --strict
scripts.render:portrait: HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 hyperframes render dist --composition portrait/index.html --output renders/website-history-portrait.mp4 --fps 30 --quality delivery --experimental-fast-capture=false
scripts.render:square: HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 hyperframes render dist --composition square/index.html --output renders/website-history-square.mp4 --fps 30 --quality delivery --experimental-fast-capture=false
scripts.render:landscape: HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 hyperframes render dist --composition landscape/index.html --output renders/website-history-landscape.mp4 --fps 30 --quality delivery --experimental-fast-capture=false
